diff: git diff 8c5ac50..HEAD — the whole feature branch against the commit its first story started from. Everything before 8c5ac50 on this branch is specification and planning artefacts.
why_security_lens: The diff adds the package's first pages readable by anonymous visitors: URL parameters looked up through the ORM, stored HTML written with |safe, and a new write guard (slug freeze) on documents.
known_and_not_findings: tests/test_models.py TestDocument inline creations gained slugs and test_document_holds_no_wording's field set gained 'slug' (decisions.md D2) — authorised.
tests/test_app.py: two tests that asserted no mvp_compliance.urls module were replaced (decisions.md D4) — later spec supersedes.
tests/test_urls.py: 'versions' moved out of the must-not-resolve cases into a test that it resolves to the list (D5).

Migration 0007 uses default='' / preserve_default=False and fails on a database holding two or more documents. Nothing is released; the maintainer ruled development databases are rebuilt (spec Clarifications). Not a finding.
The <slug:slug> path converter accepts capitals/underscores; the lowercase rule is enforced on full_clean (admin). A slug written through the ORM that breaks the rule still serves. Accepted.

Django's slug converter vs lowercase validator, and the use of |safe on stored html (sanitised at publication by the configured renderer, Article XIII) are by design; docs/pages.md states the renderer caveat.
